verdict.rationale: HeyGen's docs say Photo Avatars animate the face and sync lip movements to your script, and that cinematic avatars layer scene direction on top of avatar speech. AI dubbing is documented as including lip sync, and community viewers of the HeyGen-dubbed Davos speech praised how convincing the lip-synced result was. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of lip-syncing to user-uploaded audio (rather than script-driven TTS), and in-depth docs on lip-sync accuracy controls.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio
